items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did you see Goldkett? [INTERVIEWER] I didn't get to see Goldkett, but I've heard him on the radio...

ctx.x: there in Chicago, in 1929. They were playing "She's Funny That Way", you know -- "I'm not much to look at, nothing to see; just good on living and lucky to be" -- that tune. And then they played "Wear a Hat With a Silver Lining". And that was beautiful; I loved that. And during the stage shows I'd be inside, and then during the picture I'd be out and waiting for the next stage show, and I just hung around there all day. Didn't have nothin' to do but listen to music. And that was one of the experiences that I had…

I didn't get to see Goldkett, but I've heard him on the radio, and then I -- that was at the Oriental Theater was a fellow by the name of Victor Young who later went to, went on to Hollywood to, to be an orchestra leader there. And he was at the Oriental Theater then, and I used to go hear him all the time.
